candidate_relations.label: Embolic disease, infrarenal IVC and left pulmonary artery
candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver, a primary hepatic neoplasm. The IVC thrombus and pulmonary artery embolus identified on CT are complications or associated findings of the primary tumor, not the underlying diagnostic entity. The candidate captures downstream thromboembolic manifestations but entirely omits the primary diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Describes thromboembolic complications (IVC thrombus and pulmonary embolus) rather than the primary hepatic mass diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Classic presentation of undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver in a pediatric patient: large mixed solid-cystic right hepatic lobe mass with IVC compression and thromboembolic complications
Candidate addresses only secondary complications, not the primary diagnosis requested
